description: Implementation of GenericDataService for handling database queries, result set processing, and metadata retrieval within the Fineract project.

classes.name: GenericDataServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing data query and processing logic for Fineract.

methods.name: fillGenericResultSet
methods.description: Executes SQL query and constructs a GenericResultsetData object with column headers and data rows.

methods.name: fillResultsetColumnHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs column header metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: fillResultsetRowData
methods.description: Populates data rows for a given SQL query and column headers.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a pattern in a string with a specified replacement.

methods.name: wrapSQL
methods.description: Wraps SQL to prevent errors and malicious input.

methods.name: generateJsonFromGenericResultsetData
methods.description: Converts a GenericResultsetData object into a JSON string.

methods.name: isExplicitlyUnique
methods.description: Checks if a column has a unique constraint based on index data.

methods.name: isExplicitlyIndexed
methods.description: Checks if a column is explicitly indexed.

methods.name: checkKeyPresent
methods.description: Helper method to verify presence of a key in index definitions.

methods.name: getDatatableIndexData
methods.description: Retrieves index details for a specified table.

methods.name: retrieveCodeValues
methods.description: Fetches code values for a given code name from the database.

methods.name: getTableMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.
